images.title: A fern made of smaller ferns
images.purpose: Show self-similarity: one leaf of a fern is a smaller copy of the whole fern.
images.composition: One large fern frond centred on white, with one leaf circled and a single zoom circle to its right showing that leaf enlarged; plenty of white space around both.
images.exact_structure: One fern frond, drawn upright and filling about two thirds of the frame height, slightly left of centre, flat green #009E73 with a thin dark outline: a single central stem with 8 leaves on the left and 8 leaves on the right, alternating, getting smaller towards the tip; each leaf is itself a small frond with a little stem and tiny sub-leaves along it. The third leaf from the bottom on the right side is ringed by a thin circle in #CC79A7. A thin #CC79A7 line joins that ring to one larger circle on the right side of the frame (about 40 percent of the frame height) that shows the same leaf enlarged: it has the same shape as the whole frond, a central stem with 8 sub-leaves on each side getting smaller towards its tip. Label 'whole fern' under the frond, 'one leaf' beside the small ring and 'a smaller fern' under the big circle. No other plants, ground, sky or scenery.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Each leaf of a fern looks like a smaller copy of the whole fern.
images.description: Show self-similarity: one leaf of a fern is a smaller copy of the whole fern.
images.context: One clean concept image for T1.C1.

image_decisions.why: Self-similarity is a visual idea; seeing a leaf beside the whole fern makes the word 'fractal' concrete.
